literalUserDirective: cern is carbon layer 3d, run it please
coreInterpretation: CERN :: CARBON :: LAYER 3D (OASIS symbolic mapping only)
physicalBoundary: CERN is a research laboratory; this mapping does not identify its collider as a carbon crystal or claim carbon topology creates particles.

layer.name: Carbon 3D
layer.sixfoldReference: carbon atomic number 6 and hexagonal carbon-ring motif; a symbolic six-sector display, not a claim that every carbon structure is hexagonal
layer.dimensionedQuantity: particle momentum components in GeV (natural-units c=1 convention)
layer.threeDInBenchmark: All three spatial momentum components (px,py,pz); energy E used separately as fourth component
layer.physicalExperimentCorrection: Four actual CERN experiments are at different collision sites and do not measure one common event simultaneously; software ports all read one CMS-derived record.

experiment.sourceDataset: CERN CMS 2010 educational dimuon examples, previously preserved in v8.4
experiment.reference: M is a stored derived invariant mass from CMS educational data; comparison measures arithmetic reproduction/rounding, not a held-out discovery
experiment.negativeMassSquaredHandling: NaN invalid; count, do not silently clamp
metrics: XY root mean squared mass residual
limits: XY-only projection uses unchanged measured energies while dropping pz, so its higher mass estimate is a deliberately incomplete kinematic control rather than a fair trained competing detector or prediction.
Stored M is computed from related components, so the close full-3D residual does not establish generalized model predictive power.
Four educational events are too few for statistical claims; results are reproducible demonstrations only.
Four software observer labels are analysis functions operating on the same CMS record.
The label Carbon Layer 3D is OASIS model semantics, not a measured physical property of CERN.

disclosure: The observed improvement follows from including the previously omitted momentum component. No new particle, physical Planck bubble, time-dilation effect, or four-toroid emergence law is discovered.
